about: 'Explore the infinite world of Hatsune Miku through the most comprehensive Project DIVA game ever released!
Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Future Tone Prelude comes with two songs and modules to customize. To unlock the full potential of Future Tone, purchase the two packs bursting with 220 songs:

'Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA - Future Sound' includes a collection of songs spanning past Project DIVA titles, including the original PlayStation®Portable series (never released outside Japan) and the F series on Playstation®Vita and PlayStation®3.
'Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA - Colorful Tone' is a collection of songs from Project DIVA Arcade, many which are unique to the arcades, as well as songs from the super popular Project Mirai DX.
In addition, purchase of both expansions will unlock Survival Courses and Hairstyle Customization!'
This product supports the following languages: English
PlayStation®Move navigation controller or Wireless Controller optional.
